done_when: A task's review reads the story doc (its row, Done-when items and details) from the same place forge task start does: the story branch's copy while the story branch exists, else the default branch's. A command-level test edits a task's row on the story branch after approval and shows the review prompt carries the edited row.
why: A task's review reads the story doc from the default branch while forge next and forge task start read it from the story branch, so a plan edit made in the story worktree after approval never reaches the reviewer and the review raises findings for work the plan moved to another task
